hooks.statusMessage: Checking docs/ is up to date
hooks.command: base=$(git merge-base origin/main HEAD 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; [ -n "$base" ] || exit 0; changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base"...HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$changed" ] || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$changed" | grep -q '^docs/TASKS\.md$' && exit 0; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"PROJECT RULE: every PR reviews docs/ and updates docs/TASKS.md. This branch changes files but does not touch docs/TASKS.md. Before pushing: tick the checkboxes for completed work, update the Status column and the legend date, refresh the status note under each task touched, and check whether docs/HLD.md or docs/LLD.md now contradict the code. If no docs change is genuinely needed, say so explicitly in the PR description rather than skipping it silently."}}'
